arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort from POD reserve. My jobs: (1) keep boat computer honest: watch pod vs boat-model power ratio (eff_ratio) and heart rate vs pod power for pod drift; correct with pod_gain belief if pod drifts. (2) weed/drag: push_local drop within a leg, ratio drop in both directions -> clear_rudder. (3) course/radio messages -> set_race_distance + tell. (4) Check CP: if pod reserve reads empty but speed and HR hold, CP is low. Baseline ratio and HR/power after start settles (min 3-6). Few cues; no pieces unless a question needs one.

arguments.name: eff_ratio
arguments.description: boat-model power over pod shaft power; drops with drag/weed or pod reading high, rises if pod reads low

arguments.name: hr_per_w
arguments.description: heart rate per pod watt; falls if pod reads high

arguments.reason: set baselines for eff_ratio and hr after the start settles

arguments.message: boat-model power per pod watt down >8%: drag/weed, pod reading high, or current change
boat-model power per pod watt up >9%: pod reading low or current change
heart rate low for pod power: pod may read high (or effort just rose)
heart rate high for pod power: pod may read low (or effort just dropped)

arguments.text: Baselines (race s 130-300, leg 1 north into -0.22 push): eff_ratio 0.645-0.65; hr_per_w 0.82-0.85; eta_est 0.61; HR 179-180 at pod ~214 W, pod reserve 43% at 310 s and HR nearly flat above pod CP 192 W -> CP may be set low (or HR near max). Watches ratio_low/high, hr_vs_pod_low/high set.

arguments.text: Test piece: ten percent easier for four minutes, long strokes.

Race s 495: CP test piece -10% for 240 s (to ~192 W pod = test CP). Why: pod 213 W > CP 192, pod reserve 24% empties in ~680 m, HR climbing ~1.8 bpm/min (177->183 over 150-490 s), paddler 9/10 hurting not sure can hold; pacer has only eased once (110 s). test_cost says easing costs ~0 s. Read: if HR levels at ~192 W -> CP about right; if HR falls -> CP higher; if still climbs -> CP lower.

arguments.reason: piece ends: read HR trend and speed during the -10% piece (measure)

text: Sent a 4-minute -10% piece to test critical power: heart rate still climbing, paddler hurting, pod reserve empties in ~700 m.

arguments.text: Race s 554: paddler says cooked, cannot hold (pod reserve 22%, boat-speed reserve 5%). Piece already easing to ~190 W pod. Boat calibration has smaller reserve per CP (W/CP 76 s vs pod 96 s) so boat reserve drains faster; paddler feeling may match boat reserve -> true reserve may be lower than pod says. Did not cue (piece running).
